settings.text:
Kris offers two levels of private coaching:
VIP Standard and VIP+.

Both programs are designed for individuals who are serious about transforming their health, physique, performance, and long-term habits through a fully personalized and holistic approach.

Every VIP Client Receives:

  • Fully customized nutrition plan
  • Personalized training program
  • Individualized biohacking protocol
  • Customized supplement strategy
  • Cardio plan tailored to each person's goals
  • Ongoing accountability and progress tracking

Every recommendation is built around an individual's unique goals, lifestyle, training experience, health history, and schedule. The focus is not only on results, but on creating sustainable habits that last well beyond the coaching period.
